verdict.rationale: The evidence documents human code review on pull requests and AGit workflows, plus general extensibility through Gitea Actions, the API, webhooks and an official MCP server. Nothing in the pack shows that Gitea offers an AI reviewer, or that one can be assigned as the initial reviewer on a pull request. Building one from Actions or webhooks is possible in principle but has no supporting evidence here, so the capability is applicable but unevidenced.
